nodes.description: Internal function createProxy(address target, bytes32 salt) that builds minimal-proxy creation bytecode and deploys it with the create2 opcode, returning the deployed address.

Public function deployModule(address masterCopy, bytes memory initializer, uint256 saltNonce) that derives a salt, calls createProxy, then performs a low-level call on the new proxy with attacker-supplied initializer calldata.
Parameter target of createProxy: master copy address that is embedded into the proxy deployment bytecode.
Parameter salt of createProxy: CREATE2 salt controlling the deterministic proxy address.
Parameter masterCopy of deployModule: address of the implementation used as the proxy target.
Parameter initializer of deployModule: arbitrary calldata executed against the freshly created proxy via a low-level call.
Parameter saltNonce of deployModule: nonce mixed into the keccak256 hash to derive the CREATE2 salt.
Local variable result in createProxy holding the address returned by the create2 assembly call.
Local variable proxy in deployModule holding the address returned by createProxy and later used as the low-level call target.
Local variable deployment in createProxy holding the packed minimal-proxy bytecode plus target address.
Local variable success in deployModule holding the boolean result of the low-level call, checked by a require statement.
Low-level external call proxy.call(initializer) forwarding arbitrary attacker-controlled calldata to a newly deployed proxy contract.
Inline-assembly create2(0, add(deployment, 0x20), mload(deployment), salt) deployment of the minimal proxy.

edges.reason: deployModule invokes createProxy to deploy the proxy at the derived salt.
masterCopy is passed as the target argument into createProxy.
target is validated against address(0) and consumed by createProxy logic.
initializer is hashed to derive the salt used in deployModule.
saltNonce is mixed into the keccak256 hash that forms the CREATE2 salt.
salt flows into the create2 assembly instruction as the deployment salt.
target address is packed into the minimal-proxy bytecode consumed by create2.
deployment bytecode buffer is read from memory and passed to the create2 opcode.
The address returned by createProxy flows back into deployModule as the proxy variable.
proxy address is the receiver of the low-level call, allowing arbitrary code execution during deployModule.
initializer is forwarded verbatim as calldata to the proxy contract during the low-level call.
The low-level call executes external code that can call back into deployModule before the function completes.
success boolean returned by the low-level call is used in a require check inside deployModule.

normalization_plan.reason: target is only used as an input to createProxy and is embedded into the proxy bytecode there.
salt is only consumed by the create2 deployment inside createProxy.
masterCopy is an argument of deployModule and only forwarded to createProxy from it.
initializer is an argument of deployModule, hashed for the salt and forwarded as call data.
saltNonce is an argument of deployModule used solely to derive the CREATE2 salt.
result is the return value produced by the create2 operation inside createProxy.
proxy is the address returned by createProxy and used as the low-level call target within deployModule.
deployment is a temporary memory buffer only used for the create2 deployment inside createProxy.
success is the boolean result of the low-level call and is only used in the require check of deployModule.
